notes: This catalog is not a full product feasibility engine.
KV6 remains authoritative for upstream product configuration feasibility.
This catalog validates only local part-scope conditions relevant to Mother DXF authoring, preview, child generation, resolver consistency, slot mapping, and technology-profile-aware execution intent.

SPLO_CONTEXT_PROGRAM_MUST_BE_INOX.label: SPLO context program must be INOX
SPLO_CONTEXT_PROGRAM_MUST_BE_INOX.description: Preview and child generation for SPLO are valid only when the locked session context is inside the INOX program.

SPLO_PARAMETER_CATALOG_MUST_BE_INOX_V0.label: SPLO parameter catalog must be parameter_catalog_inox_v0
SPLO_PARAMETER_CATALOG_MUST_BE_INOX_V0.description: SPLO authoring and preview must resolve parameters from the INOX legality catalog artifact.

SPLO_NOMINAL_SET_MUST_BE_SUDOPERI_SCOPE.label: SPLO nominal set must be SUDOPERI scoped
SPLO_NOMINAL_SET_MUST_BE_SUDOPERI_SCOPE.description: SPLO should consume a family-scoped SUDOPERI nominal value set rather than a part-private nominal artifact.

SPLO_GEOMETRY_CONTEXT_REQUIRED.label: SPLO geometry context required
SPLO_GEOMETRY_CONTEXT_REQUIRED.description: SPLO authoring, preview, and child flow require a computed geometry_context_v1.

SPLO_SLOT_MODEL_REQUIRED.label: SPLO slot model required
SPLO_SLOT_MODEL_REQUIRED.description: SPLO uses slot-aware authoring and therefore requires an observed slot model before execution intent is considered valid.

SPLO_REQUIRED_VARIANT_MUST_BE_MAPPED.label: Required variant must be mapped to a slot
SPLO_REQUIRED_VARIANT_MUST_BE_MAPPED.description: When expected variant policy is required, the required slot-context variant must be present in execution intent mapping.

SPLO_PJOVER_FLAG_MUST_MATCH_VARIANT_KEY.label: PJOVER flag must match slot-context variant
SPLO_PJOVER_FLAG_MUST_MATCH_VARIANT_KEY.description: For SPLO slot-context variants, pjover=Da maps to PJOVER and pjover=Ne maps to BASE.

SPLO_SEMANTIC_VARIANT_ALZATINA_IS_NOT_SL.label: Alzatina variants are semantic in-slot variants
SPLO_SEMANTIC_VARIANT_ALZATINA_IS_NOT_SL.description: Ploča alzatina variants are activated inside the selected slot through SEM or block authoring and must not be treated as slot-authoritative variants.

SPLO_OFFSET_K_RANGE_VALID.label: K sink offset must be in allowed range
SPLO_OFFSET_K_RANGE_VALID.description: Sink offsets used by SPLO child geometry must remain inside the legality range accepted by the INOX catalog.

SPLO_K2_FIELDS_REQUIRED_WHEN_K2_USED.label: K2 companion fields required when second sink is used
SPLO_K2_FIELDS_REQUIRED_WHEN_K2_USED.description: A narrower parameter set is legal, but when SPLO child rules use Korito 2, the companion orientation, faucet, and offset fields must also be available.

SPLO_FORCE_ASSIGN_IS_AUTHORITATIVE.label: Force assignment is authoritative for SPLO authoring
SPLO_FORCE_ASSIGN_IS_AUTHORITATIVE.description: Manual force layer assignment overrides draft slot-aware auto-assignment and must be preserved until explicitly changed.

SPLO_PREVIEW_REQUIRES_EXECUTION_INTENT.label: Preview requires execution intent
SPLO_PREVIEW_REQUIRES_EXECUTION_INTENT.description: SPLO preview must not implicitly default to slot 0 or BASE when an execution-intent decision is required.

SPLO_WYSIWYG_MISMATCH_BLOCKS_CHILD.label: WYSIWYG mismatch blocks child
SPLO_WYSIWYG_MISMATCH_BLOCKS_CHILD.description: SPLO child generation must stop when current UI projection and resolver input/output hashes no longer describe the same execution state.

SPLO_ROUTER_SLOT_IS_TECHNOLOGY_PROFILE_A.label: Router slot is a technology-profile branch
SPLO_ROUTER_SLOT_IS_TECHNOLOGY_PROFILE_A.description: A future Router slot may carry the same or similar product geometry as a Laser slot while representing a different manufacturing path. Technology profile must therefore be tracked independently from slot variant semantics.
